turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Here’s the scoop:

If the order is still unfulfilled and hasn’t shipped yet, it may be cancelable.
Once it’s fulfilled or tracking has been added, it can’t be canceled.
There isn’t a customer-facing “guaranteed time window” I can quote, because it really comes down to the live status of the order at the moment we check it.

If you want, send me your order number or the email used at checkout and I can check whether your order is still eligible 👀
